summary: Your run figures are back, and the ServiceNow hand-off is prepared from every run.

new.title: Build a presentation from the Executive report
new.text: A wizard builds a PowerPoint presentation from the Executive report. The monthly management pack is attached to the management summary mail.

fixes.title: Finding counts are back
fixes.text: What was new, seen again, reopened and closed shows again in the log, the run record and the mail, so every close is counted.

fixes.title: ServiceNow hand-off prepared from every run
fixes.text: The configuration items for ServiceNow are prepared from every run. The check before each send no longer needs ServiceNow's table list; without it only the column check is left out, with a warning.

fixes.title: Clearer ServiceNow messages and setup list
fixes.text: A refusal says what ServiceNow said. The page for your ServiceNow team lists the user, every role, the table settings and every call SecurityInsight makes.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: A step whose job stops before it begins is started again once, and the column fill check no longer reports blank columns that are not blank.
